description: This file implements part of the control functions for an 'Ansc Module Container' object, specifically the functions for registering and dispatching interfaces. It includes placeholder functions that currently do not perform any operation and simply return an 'unapplicable' status.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS AnscMcoRegisterIfs(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Registers all interface objects; currently a placeholder that always returns 'unapplicable'.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS AnscMcoDispatchIfs(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hIqcIf)
methods.description: Dispatches interface objects using the provided Interface Query Controller; currently a placeholder that always returns 'unapplicable'.
